# New Applicant

##### First Time Applicants

_**First time applicants**_ who wish to obtain a CCW Permit in the State of Ohio must complete a Firearms Safety Course with a Certified Instructor consisting of 8 hours (6 hours of classroom instruction, and 2 hours of safety/competency with live range time).  Your Certificate is valid for 3 years from date of issuance.

##### Out of State Certificates

_**Out of State Certificates**_ can only be accepted if they meet the State of Ohio Competency Course, are within 3 years of the issue date, and the Instructor is an NRA Certified Instructor.

##### To Apply

- Review List of [Disqualifications](https://www.hcso.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Disqualifications.pdf)
- Have the following documents required for upload:

- Competency Certificate
- Valid State Issued ID (e.g. Driver’s License)
- Bring a valid state issued ID to your appointment
- [Apply here](https://hamiltonsooh.permitium.com/ccw/application?permittype=new)
